descriptions.w3d_d20a_bomber_position_8002f098: Bomber start position: reads Gravity (or Gravity.Slow when the owner's +516 flag is set) scaled by Low.Gravity.Multiplier, Bomber.ExtraHeight, Land.MaxHeight and Bomber.GroundSpeed through 0x800fc270; returns the position at height MaxHeight+ExtraHeight, moved back along the normalized direction by GroundSpeed times the fall ticks (int sqrt(2*drop/-gravity)) unless the +480 flag is set.
